## Names

<a id="read_joystick"></a>
### [`read_joystick`](../../../../src/input/joystick.asm#L6) `$864A`

*routine*

Reads the joystick port that $1d selects ($dc00 + $1d: 0 = port 2, 1 = port 1). Stores the inverted bits in $1b: 1 = pressed, bit 4 = fire. Keeps X.

- **Called from:** [`attract_check_fire`](joystick.md#attract_check_fire) [`$8658`](../../../../src/input/joystick.asm#L18), [`$917A`](../../../../src/player/gordon_joystick.asm#L15), [`dog_command`](../dog/dog_command.md#dog_command) [`$95C0`](../../../../src/dog/dog_command.asm#L7), [`init_hiscores`](../scores/hiscores.md#init_hiscores) [`$9F19`](../../../../src/scores/hiscores.asm#L188)
- **Reads:** [`joy_port`](../../memory-map.md#joy_port), [`CIAPRA`](../../memory-map.md#CIAPRA)
- **Writes:** [`joy_bits`](../../memory-map.md#joy_bits)

<a id="attract_check_fire"></a>
### [`attract_check_fire`](../../../../src/input/joystick.asm#L17) `$8658`

*routine*

One delay step of the title and the attract screens. When fire is pressed, it jumps to the setup screen at $7cde and does not return. Else it starts the main tune again when it has ended.

- **Called from:** [`show_high_scores`](../scores/high_score_screen.md#show_high_scores) [`$7C75`](../../../../src/scores/high_score_screen.asm#L70), [`$8444`](../../../../src/title/title_mower.asm#L61), [`$854A`](../../../../src/title/title_walk.asm#L34), [`$8582`](../../../../src/title/title_walk.asm#L62), [`$8598`](../../../../src/title/title_walk.asm#L74), [`$85B6`](../../../../src/title/title_walk.asm#L89), [`$85E5`](../../../../src/title/title_walk.asm#L113), [`$8635`](../../../../src/title/title_walk.asm#L154)
- **Calls:** [`read_joystick`](joystick.md#read_joystick)
- **Jumps to:** [`restart_tune_if_ended`](../music/tune_start.md#restart_tune_if_ended), [`setup_screen`](../setup/setup_screen.md#setup_screen)
- **Reads:** [`joy_bits`](../../memory-map.md#joy_bits)
